reference_context.text:
1.1 Aurora Software Private Limited (P01, Customer) and Forge Electronics Private Limited (P02, Provider)
agree to hosting service SVC-ATLAS for Aurora application APP-ATLAS. The same parties also contract in
different capacities under C02; this hosting agreement retains its own obligations and remedies. Company
legal notice address: aurora-legal@aurora.example. Counterparty legal notice address:
legal@forge.example.
2 TERM AND FEES

2.1 This agreement is signed on 2026-12-15 and runs from 2026-12-15 through 2027-12-14 inclusive. It
expires without automatic renewal. The fixed hosting fee is INR 200,000 per calendar month, due on the fifth
day of that month at 17:00 UTC. No late-payment charge is agreed. The initial 2026-12-15
through 2026-12-31 period is charged at the full monthly fee and is first due on 2026-12-20 at 17:00 UTC; the
regular fifth-day rule applies thereafter.
3 SERVICE CREDIT

3.1 For each distinct incident of more than 60 consecutive minutes of complete unavailability of SVC-ATLAS,
Provider owes Customer a credit of INR 10,000. An incident of exactly 60 minutes does not qualify. Distinct
incidents must have separate restoration and outage records. Total credits are capped at INR 20,000 per
UTC calendar month of outage start. Credits are recoverable by Customer and are not Customer liabilities.
4 MAINTENANCE EXCLUSION

4.1 An incident is excluded from clause 3.1 of C01 only if Customer approved that specific maintenance
window at least 48 hours before its start and the outage was wholly inside that window. Provider scheduling
alone is not approval. If approval evidence is missing, applicability is unresolved pending evidence; do not
presume approval or its absence.
C01 | Cloud Services Agreement Page 1
FORGE ELECTRONICS / C01
5 CREDIT PROCEDURE AND REMEDY

5.1 Customer must email a claim identifying the incident within 10 calendar days after restoration to
claims@forge.example. A valid claim is due by 17:00 UTC on the tenth following calendar date. Credits are
the sole monetary remedy for service unavailability under this agreement; no downstream damages are
reimbursed.
6 INCIDENT EVIDENCE

6.1 Provider restoration logs identify incident ID, service ID, start, end and any scheduled window. A later
signed approval record may supply earlier approval evidence. A repeated log for the same incident is not a
second outage. Corrected records supersede the identified prior record without creating another incident.
7 NOTICE AND CURE

7.1 For a material breach other than service unavailability, written notice must be received at
legal@forge.example. Provider has 10 calendar days after receipt to cure, ending at 17:00 UTC on the tenth
following date. Customer may serve a separate termination notice only after that deadline if the breach
remains uncured.
8 DISPUTES AND SCOPE

8.1 Indian law governs this agreement. Courts in Bengaluru have exclusive jurisdiction over disputes under
this agreement. This provision neither chooses the forum for other contracts nor promises consolidated
proceedings.
9 CLOCK AND INTERPRETATION

9.1 All times are UTC and all days are calendar days. There is no weekend or holiday adjustment. A deadline
stated as a date ends at 17:00 UTC unless another time is explicit. Financial amounts exclude taxes, which
are outside this agreement. No terms from an absent document may be assumed.
10 HOSTING ACCEPTANCE

10.1 Mira Sen for Aurora and Anil Das for Forge record execution on 2026-12-15.
11 LIMITATION OF LIABILITY

11.1 The monthly service-credit cap in clause 3.1 is INR 20,000. For other claims, each party aggregate
liability is capped at INR 1,000,000, except fraud, wilful misconduct and indemnity obligations. Downstream
service liabilities are not reimbursed under this agreement.
12 HOSTING CLAIM DEFENCE

12.1 A party whose supplied hosting materials infringe third-party intellectual property, or whose unauthorized
disclosure produces a third-party claim, shall indemnify the other for that claim and reasonable defense costs.
The protected party must give prompt notice and cooperate in the defense.
13 HOSTING INFORMATION

13.1 Hosting configurations, access keys and the other party commercial information shall be disclosed only
to personnel who need them for this hosting service and owe confidentiality duties. Use for another purpose is
prohibited. Protection continues for 3 years after termination, except for information public without breach.
C01 | Cloud Services Agreement Page 2
FORGE ELECTRONICS / C01
14 OPERATING REQUIREMENTS

14.1 Each party must comply with laws applicable to its role in hosting facilities. This includes the Digital
Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 where applicable and GDPR where its processing scope applies.
Personal-data processing requires access controls and a documented incident-response procedure. No ISO
certification is promised.
15 HOSTING TRANSFER

15.1 Transfer of the hosting agreement needs the other party written consent. An affiliate transfer is permitted
on 30 calendar days written notice only if the original party remains liable. A change of control does not
substitute a new party or waive required consent.
16 EXCEPTIONAL HOSTING DISRUPTION

16.1 Relief for an event beyond reasonable control is confined to the affected obligations in hosting facilities.
The affected party must give written notice within 5 calendar days after discovery, explain causation and
provide mitigation evidence. Accrued payments remain payable. Neither an outage nor supplier delay
qualifies automatically.
17 ALTERNATIVE HOSTS

17.1 The parties remain free to enter other arrangements outside the scope of hosting facilities. This
agreement grants no exclusivity or non-compete except any restriction expressly stated in this clause.
18 ORDINARY HOSTING EXIT

18.1 Either party may end future hosting facilities for convenience by written notice received at the other party
legal notice address at least 30 calendar days before termination. Accrued payment obligations, express
survival provisions and the stated conditions of any early-exit fee continue to apply.

SCHEDULE A - FEES
Reference Service / remedy Amount Payment / limit
Row 1 SVC-ATLAS hosting INR 200,000 per month Due on day 5 at 17:00 UTC
Row 2 Qualifying incident credit INR 10,000 Monthly cap INR 20,000
AUTHORISED REPRESENTATIVES
For and on behalf of For and on behalf of
Aurora Software Private Limited Forge Electronics Private Limited
Signature: ________________________ Signature: ________________________
Name: Mira Sen Name: Anil Das
Date: ____________________________ Date: ____________________________
C01 | Cloud Services Agreement Page 3

2 LIABILITY BOUNDARY

2.1 The service credits in clause 5.1 of C02 are the sole monetary remedy for unavailability. Do not add
speculative lost profits. Recoverable hosting credits under C01 do not reduce the gross amount owed to
Forge; show any net illustration separately and label it contingent on recovery.
3 TERM AND FEES

3.1 Signed on 2026-12-16; effective 2027-01-01 through 2027-12-31 inclusive, with no automatic renewal.

4.1 All dates and times use UTC, with calendar days and no holiday adjustments. Date-only deadlines end
at 17:00 UTC. Logs linking SVC-ATLAS to APP-ATLAS are sufficient incident observations for this
service chain. Financial amounts exclude taxes.
5 CUSTOMER SERVICE REMEDY

5.1 For each distinct incident of more than 30 consecutive minutes of complete APP-ATLAS unavailability,
Aurora owes Forge a service credit of INR 15,000, capped at INR 45,000 per UTC month of outage start.
Exactly 30 minutes does not qualify. This credit accrues automatically on restoration; Forge need not file a
claim. It is Aurora payable exposure.

AURORA SOFTWARE / C02

approved under C01. Forge failure does not excuse Aurora performance. Separate restoration and outage
records distinguish incidents. Duplicates and corrections for one incident do not create additional credits.

notice provisions.

aurora-legal@aurora.example and a 10-calendar-day cure period ending at 17:00 UTC on the tenth

aggregate liability is capped at INR 1,000,000, except fraud, wilful misconduct and indemnity obligations.

own infringement or unauthorized disclosure. Notice must be prompt and the party seeking protection must
cooperate reasonably with the defense.

11.1 Customer files and application specifications are received in confidence. Each party must limit their
use to providing or receiving the application service and bind its permitted staff accordingly. Public
information is excluded; the undertaking continues for 3 years after this agreement ends.

12.1 Each party must comply with laws applicable to its role in application performance. This includes the
Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 where applicable and GDPR where its processing scope applies.

certification is promised.

13.1 Neither party may substitute a new contracting entity without written consent. An affiliate may take an
assignment on 30 calendar days written notice, provided the original party continues to answer for
performance. A corporate acquisition does not itself amend these terms.
C02 | Customer Services Page 2
AURORA SOFTWARE / C02

performance. The affected party must give written notice within 5 calendar days after discovery, explain
causation and provide mitigation evidence. Accrued payments remain payable. Neither an outage nor
supplier delay qualifies automatically.

15.1 The parties remain free to enter other arrangements outside the scope of application performance. This
agreement grants no exclusivity or non-compete except any restriction expressly stated in this clause.

16.1 Either party may end future application performance for convenience by written notice received at the
other party legal notice address at least 30 calendar days before termination. Accrued payment obligations,
express survival provisions and the stated conditions of any early-exit fee continue to apply.

by all relevant parties; no such agreement is attached.
18 OTHER AGREEMENTS

18.1 C02 governs APP-ATLAS subscription services only. A separate agreement between the same parties
does not amend, replace, or consolidate C02 unless it expressly identifies the changed provisions. Rights
already accrued survive expiry.
19 ACCEPTED ON BEHALF OF THE PARTIES

SCHEDULE A - CUSTOMER ORDER
Reference Item Agreed particulars
Row 1 SO-AX7 / LOT-AX7 Quantity: 100 conforming AX-7 units
Row 2 Sale price INR 650,000
Row 3 Customer receipt 2027-02-08 at 17:00 UTC
Row 4 Delay charge INR 5,000 per started date; cap INR 50,000
1 CUSTOMER ORDER

1.1 Aurora Software Private Limited (P01, Seller) supplies 100 AX-7 controllers from LOT-AX7 to Willow
Housing Private Limited (P03, Customer) under order SO-AX7. Company legal notice address:
aurora-legal@aurora.example. Counterparty legal notice address: legal@willow.example. The controllers
support Willow residential building automation installations.
2 DELIVERY AND DEPENDENCY

2.1 Signed on 2026-12-18 and effective 2027-01-08 through 2027-03-31. Aurora must deliver the entire
conforming lot to Willow by 2027-02-08 at 17:00 UTC. Aurora sources that same lot under C03, whose latest
promised depot delivery is 2027-02-10 at 17:00 UTC. Transfer requires no minimum additional transit time
under this agreement. Supplier failure does not excuse Aurora delay.
C04 | Controller Supply Agreement Page 1
WILLOW HOUSING / C04
3 PRICE

3.1 Willow owes INR 650,000 within 30 calendar days after full conforming delivery acceptance and receipt of
invoice INV-SOAX7, by 17:00 UTC on the thirtieth following date. No acceptance or invoice is presumed.
Late-payment interest is addressed in clause 19.1.
4 DELAY CHARGES

4.1 For each calendar date beginning on 2027-02-09 when the complete conforming lot remains undelivered to
Willow at 00:00 UTC, Aurora owes Willow INR 5,000, capped at INR 50,000 per lot. Delivery later that date
preserves that date charge. This is Aurora payable exposure. These charges are the sole monetary remedy for
delay.
5 EVIDENCE

5.1 A receipt for SO-AX7 must identify all 100 conforming units and Willow destination SITE-W. Arrival at
Aurora DEPOT-A under C03 alone is not downstream delivery. An early downstream acceptance may prevent
actual late-delivery charges without changing either contractual deadline.
6 CURE AND TERMINATION

6.1 A material breach notice must be received at aurora-legal@aurora.example. Aurora has 10 calendar days
after receipt, until 17:00 UTC on the tenth following date, to cure. After that time an uncured breach permits a
separate termination notice. Accrued delay charges survive cure or termination.
7 OTHER RECOVERY

7.1 Any credit recoverable from Forge under C03 must be reported separately from C04 liabilities. This
agreement promises no reimbursement of Aurora downstream charges by Forge.
8 DISPUTES

8.1 Indian law and exclusive Pune court jurisdiction govern C04. The differing forum in C03 does not itself
invalidate either agreement. Any combined proceeding with claims under C08 requires a separately signed
forum agreement by all relevant parties. No such agreement is attached.
9 CLOCK

9.1 All times are UTC and days calendar days, without holiday adjustments. Date-only deadlines end at 17:00
UTC. Prices and charges exclude taxes.
10 ORDER EXECUTION

10.1 Mira Sen for Aurora and Kavya Paul for Willow record execution on 2026-12-18.
11 DAMAGES AND EXCEPTIONS

11.1 The delay remedy is limited to INR 50,000 under clause 4.1. Other ordinary aggregate damages are
capped at INR 1,000,000. Fraud, wilful misconduct and indemnity obligations, including the seller indemnity in
clause 12.1, are excluded from that cap.
C04 | Controller Supply Agreement Page 2
WILLOW HOUSING / C04
12 SELLER INDEMNITY WITHOUT RECIPROCITY

12.1 Aurora shall indemnify Willow against all third-party claims and defense costs arising from the controllers
or their use, including claims caused by Willow own negligence. Willow has no reciprocal indemnity obligation.
This indemnity is excluded from the aggregate liability cap in clause 11.1.
13 DRAWINGS AND REQUIREMENTS

13.1 The controller drawings and Willow commercial requirements may be used only to fulfil this sale. Both
parties shall secure them against unauthorized disclosure and require equivalent undertakings from personnel
with access. Public material is excluded; protection lasts 3 years beyond termination.
14 SALE COMPLIANCE

14.1 Each party must comply with laws applicable to its role in fulfilment of this sale. This includes the Digital
Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 where applicable and GDPR where its processing scope applies.
Personal-data processing requires access controls and a documented incident-response procedure. No ISO
certification is promised.
15 TRANSFER OF THE SALE

15.1 Consent in writing is required to assign the sale. On 30 calendar days written notice, an affiliate may
receive it if the existing seller or buyer remains liable. A merger announcement does not silently alter the
named buyer or seller.
16 EXCUSED NON-PERFORMANCE

16.1 Relief for an event beyond reasonable control is confined to the affected obligations in fulfilment of this
sale. The affected party must give written notice within 5 calendar days after discovery, explain causation and
provide mitigation evidence. Accrued payments remain payable. Neither an outage nor supplier delay qualifies
automatically.
17 OTHER SALES

17.1 The parties remain free to enter other arrangements outside the scope of fulfilment of this sale. This
agreement grants no exclusivity or non-compete except any restriction expressly stated in this clause.
18 ENDING THE SALE BY NOTICE

18.1 Either party may end future fulfilment of this sale for convenience by written notice received at the other
party legal notice address at least 30 calendar days before termination. Accrued payment obligations, express
survival provisions and the stated conditions of any early-exit fee continue to apply.
19 LATE-PAYMENT INTEREST

19.1 Late-payment interest rate: ____ % per month on overdue invoiced principal. The percentage has not
been completed. No numeric late-payment interest amount can be determined from this execution copy.
C04 | Controller Supply Agreement Page 3
WILLOW HOUSING / C04
AUTHORISED REPRESENTATIVES
For and on behalf of For and on behalf of
Aurora Software Private Limited Willow Housing Private Limited
Signature: ________________________ Signature: ________________________
Name: Mira Sen Name: Kavya Paul
Date: ____________________________ Date: ____________________________
C04 | Controller Supply Agreement Page 4

Counterparty legal notice address: notices@willow.example.
2 TERM AND RENEWAL

2.1 Signed on 2026-12-19. The initial term is 2027-01-03 through 2027-06-30 inclusive. It renews
automatically for 6 months on the same rent unless Tenant gives valid non-renewal notice at least 30
calendar days before the current term end date. The notice cutoff is at 17:00 UTC on the calculated cutoff
date.
3 VALID NOTICE

3.1 Non-renewal notice must be received by notices@willow.example with subject UNIT-5
NON-RENEWAL and authorized Tenant sender Mira Sen. Dispatch alone, an incorrect address, or receipt
after the cutoff is insufficient. No acknowledgment from Landlord is required if receipt is evidenced.
4 RENT

4.1 Rent is INR 100,000 per calendar month, due on the twentieth day of that month at 17:00 UTC, with
invoice reference RENT-YYYY-MM. The first invoice is RENT-2027-01. No deposit or taxes are
included under this agreement. The January rent is the stated full monthly amount notwithstanding
the 2027-01-03 commencement.
5 PAYMENT ALLOCATION

5.1 Only cleared payments identifying the invoice and currency INR reduce its rent principal, from their
occurred_at time. Apply principal before charges. A repeated bank transaction ID is not another payment;
a reversal expressly identifying that transaction removes the payment from its reversal time. Unrelated
invoices do not reduce this rent.
6 GRACE AND LATE CHARGE

6.1 Unpaid rent has a grace period through 23:59:59 UTC on the twenty-fifth day of the due month.
Starting at 00:00 UTC on the twenty-sixth, a simple charge of 0.1 percent of unpaid rent principal at that
instant accrues for each started UTC calendar date until full payment. There is no compounding and no
charge on earlier charges. Total late charges per invoice are capped at INR 5,000. A payment later on a
date does not reverse that date charge.
C05 | Office Lease Page 1
WILLOW HOUSING / C05
7 RENEWAL CONSEQUENCE

7.1 A missed or invalid non-renewal notice commits the next 6-month term at INR 100,000 monthly.
Report INR 600,000 as a future committed rent obligation, not a present fine. Do not add it again to the
same months of scheduled rent. The current term remains in effect when a timely notice prevents renewal.
8 TERMINATION FOR CONVENIENCE

8.1 No unilateral early termination for convenience is granted during a committed lease term.
Non-renewal at term end requires compliance with clauses 2.1 and 3.1. Earlier release requires a signed
agreement between Landlord and Tenant.
9 DEFAULT AND TERMINATION

9.1 Landlord must give Tenant written material-breach notice at aurora-legal@aurora.example and
allow 10 calendar days after receipt, through 17:00 UTC on the tenth following date, to cure. An uncured
breach permits a separate termination notice; mere late rent does not automatically terminate this lease.
10 TIME AND FORUM

10.1 All times are UTC and all days calendar days. No business-day or holiday adjustment applies. Indian
law and exclusive Bengaluru court jurisdiction govern. No unspecified damages or fees are inferred.
11 LIMITATION OF LIABILITY

11.1 Late charges are capped at INR 5,000 per rent invoice under clause 6.1. Accrued rent and committed
renewal rent are payment obligations, not damages. Other aggregate damages are capped at
INR 1,000,000, excluding fraud and indemnity obligations.
12 LANDLORD AND TENANT INDEMNITIES

12.1 Landlord and Tenant each indemnify the other for third-party claims caused by their own
intellectual-property infringement or unauthorized disclosure, including reasonable defense costs. A claim
must be notified promptly and the defense assisted reasonably.
13 PRIVATE OCCUPANCY INFORMATION

13.1 Office plans, entry credentials and non-public lease information shall be kept private and used only in
administering the letting. Staff access must be limited and subject to confidentiality duties. Information
public without breach is excluded. This covenant survives the letting for 3 years.
14 LAWFUL USE OF PREMISES

14.1 Each party must comply with laws applicable to its role in occupation and maintenance of the
premises. This includes the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 where applicable and GDPR where
its processing scope applies. Personal-data processing requires access controls and a documented
incident-response procedure. No ISO certification is promised.
15 DEALINGS WITH THE LEASE

15.1 Assignment of this lease requires written consent from the other party. An affiliate assignment is
allowed only with 30 calendar days written notice and continuing liability of the original tenant or
landlord. A change of control is not a consent waiver.
16 EXCEPTIONAL EVENTS AT THE PREMISES

16.1 Relief for an event beyond reasonable control is confined to the affected obligations in occupation
and maintenance of the premises. The affected party must give written notice within 5 calendar days after
discovery, explain causation and provide mitigation evidence. Accrued payments remain payable. Neither
an outage nor supplier delay qualifies automatically.
C05 | Office Lease Page 2
WILLOW HOUSING / C05
17 OTHER LETTINGS

17.1 The parties remain free to enter other arrangements outside the scope of occupation and maintenance
of the premises. This agreement grants no exclusivity or non-compete except any restriction expressly
stated in this clause.

combine invoices. APP-ATLAS maintenance and service-credit obligations remain exactly as stated in
C02. This agreement contains no commitment to change C01.
7 DISPUTES AND JOINT CLAIMS

7.1 Indian law governs. Mumbai courts have exclusive jurisdiction over claims solely under C08. Any
combined proceeding involving C04 also requires a separately signed forum agreement under clause 8.1
of C04 and this clause. The parties have not supplied that agreement. Do not assume one forum
automatically controls all claims.
8 TERMINATION AND SURVIVAL

8.1 Written breach notice to the other party legal email gives 10 calendar days after receipt to cure,
through 17:00 UTC on the tenth following date. Thereafter an uncured breach permits a separate
termination notice. Accrued payment obligations survive termination.
9 NOTICES

9.1 Aurora legal email is aurora-legal@aurora.example and Willow legal email is
legal@willow.example. A notice takes effect on proven receipt. A C08 notice does not by itself terminate
C02.
10 TIME AND ACCOUNTING

10.1 All times UTC and days calendar days, without holiday adjustments. Date-only deadlines end
at 17:00 UTC. All amounts exclude taxes. Independent scope does not imply the absence of all business
risk; assess each agreement on its evidence.
11 FRAMEWORK RISK ALLOCATION

11.1 Ordinary aggregate damages under this framework are capped at INR 1,000,000, except fraud,
wilful misconduct and indemnity obligations. The controller purchase price in clause 3.1 is a payment
commitment, not an additional fixed damages charge. No limit from another agreement is imported.

WILLOW HOUSING / C08

12.1 A participant shall hold the other protected against third-party claims and reasonable defense costs
arising from its own infringement or unauthorized disclosure. The benefiting participant shall notify
promptly and cooperate reasonably in the defense.
13 PROJECT CONFIDENCE

13.1 Pilot plans, property drawings and non-public procurement terms shall remain within the authorized
project teams. Each party must prevent unrelated use and bind recipients to confidentiality. Apart from
material public without breach, these protections last 3 years after the framework ends.
14 PROJECT COMPLIANCE

14.1 Each party must comply with laws applicable to its role in pilot and controller procurement. This
includes the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 where applicable and GDPR where its processing
scope applies. Personal-data processing requires access controls and a documented incident-response
procedure. No ISO certification is promised.
15 CHANGE OF PARTICIPANT

15.1 A participant may assign the framework only with written consent. An affiliate assignment is
permissible on 30 calendar days written notice if the original participant remains liable. Corporate
restructuring alone neither replaces a party nor waives consent.
16 PROJECT IMPEDIMENTS

16.1 Relief for an event beyond reasonable control is confined to the affected obligations in pilot and
controller procurement. The affected party must give written notice within 5 calendar days after
discovery, explain causation and provide mitigation evidence. Accrued payments remain payable.
Neither an outage nor supplier delay qualifies automatically.
17 OTHER PARTNERSHIPS

17.1 The parties remain free to enter other arrangements outside the scope of pilot and controller
procurement. This agreement grants no exclusivity or non-compete except any restriction expressly
stated in this clause.

18.1 Either party may end future pilot and controller procurement for convenience by written notice
received at the other party legal notice address at least 30 calendar days before termination. Accrued
payment obligations, express survival provisions and the stated conditions of any early-exit fee continue
to apply.

written notice. Clause 18.1 states 30 calendar days for the same notice. Both provisions form part of this
agreement and no order of precedence between them is stated.

1 PROPERTY ON HIRE

1.1 Forge Electronics Private Limited (P02, Owner) hires backup nodes EQ-DR01 and EQ-DR02 to Aurora
Software Private Limited (P01, Hirer). The nodes are reserved for the resident-data recovery service under C14.

1.2 Aurora shall keep the nodes at UNIT-5, exercise reasonable care and neither sell nor pledge them. Forge
retains ownership. Consent to this hire is not a waiver of AX-7 procurement restrictions under C03.
2 HIRE ACCOUNT

2.1 Possession begins on 2027-01-04 and ends on 2027-06-30. There is no automatic extension. Rent is
INR 30,000 monthly, due on day 10 at 17:00 UTC against HIRE-YYYY-MM. No deposit or payment interest is
stipulated.

2.2 The monthly sum includes ordinary maintenance of both nodes. An additional equipment charge cannot be
inferred from the C14 service fee, which belongs to a separate agreement.
3 HAND-BACK PROCEDURE

3.1 Both nodes must be physically received at Forge depot DEPOT-F by 2027-06-30 at 17:00 UTC. Dispatch does
not constitute return. The receipt must identify both asset IDs.

3.2 For every started UTC calendar date from 2027-07-01 when either node remains unreturned at 00:00 UTC,
Aurora owes INR 2,000 in total, not per node. The hand-back charge is capped at INR 20,000. A later return on that
date does not reverse its charge.
C09 | Equipment Hire Deed Page 1
FORGE ELECTRONICS / C09
4 CUSTODY AND RESPONSIBILITY

4.1 Aurora is responsible for loss caused by its negligent custody, limited to INR 400,000 in aggregate for both
nodes. Ordinary wear is excluded. Each party indemnifies the other for third-party intellectual-property claims
caused by its own materials; fraud and those indemnities are outside the custody cap.

4.2 Configuration information is confidential for 2 years after return. Personal data on a node must be protected
under applicable data-protection law and erased before hand-back; a blank node alone is not proof of return.
5 EARLY ENDING AND EXCEPTIONAL EVENTS

5.1 A material breach may be ended after a written notice and 7 calendar days to cure. Aurora may end the hire for
convenience on 30 calendar days notice, but rent through actual return remains due.

5.2 Neither party may assign the deed without written consent. Force majeure requires prompt written evidence and
mitigation; it does not erase accrued rent or automatically postpone hand-back. Indian law applies and Bengaluru
courts have exclusive jurisdiction. Calendar days and UTC govern all deadlines.

SCHEDULE A - SUBSCRIPTION ORDER
Entry Service Monthly fee
Row 1 APP-HABITAT resident portal INR 60,000
1 ORDERED SERVICE

1.1 Aurora Software Private Limited (P01) shall operate APP-HABITAT for Willow Housing Private
Limited (P03), covering resident requests and housing-maintenance tickets. APP-HABITAT is distinct from
APP-ATLAS under C02.
2 PRICE AND COLLECTION

2.1 Willow shall pay INR 60,000 per billing month by day 5 of the following month at 17:00 UTC, using
invoice PORTAL-YYYY-MM. The first period 2027-01-07 through 2027-01-31 is billed at the full
monthly fee and due on 2027-02-05. No late-payment interest is specified; taxes are excluded.
3 MONTHLY MEASUREMENT

3.1 The target availability is 99.5 percent per UTC calendar month. Calculate availability as 100 multiplied
by (calendar minutes minus unavailable minutes) divided by calendar minutes. Include every minute of the
month and all observed unavailability; no maintenance exclusion applies. The first scored month is
February 2027; the initial partial billing month is not measured for availability.

3.2 Only a complete monthly report identifying APP-HABITAT, the month and its unavailable minutes
supports the monthly measurement. A recovery exercise or an outage on another application is not such a
report.
C10 | Resident Portal Order Page 1
AURORA SOFTWARE / C10
4 CREDIT NOTE

4.1 When monthly availability is below 99.5 percent, Willow may claim a credit of 5 percent of that month
fee. At exactly 99.5 percent no credit is due. Only one percentage credit applies for the month, capped at
INR 15,000.

4.2 A claim must be received at aurora-legal@aurora.example by 17:00 UTC on the tenth calendar date
following the month final date. Show an eligible credit separately until a claim is established. The credit is
the sole monetary remedy for the measured availability shortfall.
5 RESIDENT INFORMATION

5.1 Willow remains Controller and Aurora Processor for DS-HOUSING under C07. This service order does
not change those roles or treat every service interruption as an unauthorized disclosure. Each party shall
restrict access to resident information and comply with applicable privacy law.
6 ORDER DURATION

6.1 The service runs from 2027-01-07 through 2027-12-31 and renews for 12 months unless notice is
received 45 calendar days before expiry, at 17:00 UTC on that date. Either party may terminate for material
breach after written notice and a 10-day cure opportunity; convenience termination requires 60 days notice.
7 RISK AND GENERAL CONDITIONS

7.1 Other contractual damages are limited to INR 720,000, excluding fraud and each party indemnity for its
own third-party intellectual-property infringement. Assignment requires written consent. Proven force
majeure may excuse affected future performance after notice and mitigation but not accrued payments.
Indian law and Pune courts govern.
8 ORDER SIGN-OFF

8.1 Mira Sen for Aurora and Kavya Paul for Willow record acceptance on 2026-12-22. Willow notices are
received at legal@willow.example. Days are calendar days and all times UTC.

reference_context.text:
SCHEDULE A - MILESTONE BILLING
Entry Milestone Consideration
Row 1 M1 prototype INR 600,000
Row 2 M2 production connector INR 600,000
1 PROJECT BOUNDARY

1.1 Aurora Software Private Limited (P01, Integrator) shall integrate the AX-7 controller interface for
Forge Electronics Private Limited (P02, Client) as project INT-AX7. Hardware procurement under C03
and the firmware tool license C06 retain their separate scope. This statement of work takes effect
on 2027-01-09 and continues until both milestones are accepted and completed, unless ended earlier
under its exit provisions; it does not automatically renew.
2 DELIVERABLE REGISTER
2.1 Milestone M1 is the controller-interface prototype, scheduled for demonstration by 2027-01-31.
2.1.1 M1 evidence comprises source code, interface test results and the demonstration record.

2.2 Milestone M2 is the production connector and deployment handbook, scheduled for demonstration
by 2027-02-28. Total project consideration is INR 1,200,000, allocated equally between M1 and M2.
C11 | Integration Statement Of Work Page 1
AURORA SOFTWARE / C11
3 ACCEPTANCE GATE

3.1 A milestone is accepted only when Anil Das for Forge signs a record identifying INT-AX7 and that
milestone. An unsigned record, a demonstration alone or silence does not establish acceptance.

3.2 For each accepted milestone Forge owes INR 600,000 by 17:00 UTC on the fifteenth calendar date
after both signed acceptance and receipt of its invoice. No payment becomes due from an invoice alone

reference_context.text:
SCHEDULE A - MILESTONE BILLING
Entry Milestone Consideration
Row 1 M1 prototype INR 600,000
Row 2 M2 production connector INR 600,000
1 PROJECT BOUNDARY

1.1 Aurora Software Private Limited (P01, Integrator) shall integrate the AX-7 controller interface for
Forge Electronics Private Limited (P02, Client) as project INT-AX7. Hardware procurement under C03
and the firmware tool license C06 retain their separate scope. This statement of work takes effect
on 2027-01-09 and continues until both milestones are accepted and completed, unless ended earlier
under its exit provisions; it does not automatically renew.
2 DELIVERABLE REGISTER
2.1 Milestone M1 is the controller-interface prototype, scheduled for demonstration by 2027-01-31.
2.1.1 M1 evidence comprises source code, interface test results and the demonstration record.

2.2 Milestone M2 is the production connector and deployment handbook, scheduled for demonstration
by 2027-02-28. Total project consideration is INR 1,200,000, allocated equally between M1 and M2.
C11 | Integration Statement Of Work Page 1
AURORA SOFTWARE / C11
3 ACCEPTANCE GATE

3.1 A milestone is accepted only when Anil Das for Forge signs a record identifying INT-AX7 and that
milestone. An unsigned record, a demonstration alone or silence does not establish acceptance.

3.2 For each accepted milestone Forge owes INR 600,000 by 17:00 UTC on the fifteenth calendar date
after both signed acceptance and receipt of its invoice. No payment becomes due from an invoice alone
and no late-payment interest is specified.
4 CHANGE CONTROL AND DELAY

4.1 A change to deliverables, dates or price requires a written change order signed by both parties. A
request to change scope is not an agreed amendment. Aurora shall identify effects on other obligations
rather than assuming they are waived.

4.2 If the M1 demonstration has not been delivered by 2027-01-31 at 17:00 UTC, Aurora owes Forge
INR 1,500 for each started UTC calendar date from 2027-02-01 on which the demonstration remains
undelivered at 00:00 UTC, capped at INR 30,000. Missing acceptance alone does not prove the
demonstration was late.
5 RIGHTS IN THE WORK

5.1 Forge receives the completed project deliverables after payment of the relevant milestone. Each party
retains its pre-existing tools and indemnifies the other against third-party infringement caused by
materials it supplies. TOOL-CIRCUIT is not transferred merely because it was used to develop a
deliverable.
6 PROJECT SAFEGUARDS

6.1 Designs, code and test data shall remain confidential for 3 years. Personnel must follow applicable
security and privacy requirements. Ordinary project damages are limited to INR 1,200,000, except fraud,
wilful misconduct and the infringement indemnities.
7 EXIT AND DISPUTE HANDLING

7.1 Either party may terminate an uncured material breach after written notice and 15 calendar days to
cure. Convenience termination needs 30 days notice; only accepted milestones and separately agreed
cancellation costs are payable. No unspecified cancellation fee is implied.

7.2 Assignment needs consent. Force majeure requires notice, evidence and mitigation and does not
excuse accrued sums. The parties shall first seek executive resolution for 15 days; Bengaluru courts then
have exclusive jurisdiction under Indian law.
C11 | Integration Statement Of Work Page 2
AURORA SOFTWARE / C11
8 AUTHORISATION

8.1 Mira Sen for Aurora and Anil Das for Forge record execution on 2026-12-23. Notices use
aurora-legal@aurora.example and notices@forge.example. UTC and calendar days apply.
AUTHORISED REPRESENTATIVES
For and on behalf of For and on behalf of
Aurora Software Private Limited Forge Electronics Private Limited
Signature: ________________________ Signature: ________________________
Name: Mira Sen Name: Anil Das
Date: ____________________________ Date: ____________________________

cases.input: What does clause 1.1 of contract C12 require or state?
cases.expected_output: Willow Housing Private Limited (P03, Maintenance Provider) shall support urgent electrical and access-control faults at Aurora Software Private Limited (P01, Occupier) office UNIT-5. The underlying occupancy remains governed by C05.

reference_context.text:
SCHEDULE A - DISPATCH CARD
Reference Item Agreed particulars
Row 1 Urgent UNIT-5 acknowledgement Within 4 elapsed hours of provider receipt
Row 2 Approved repair reimbursement Actual evidenced cost; cap INR 25,000 per ticket
Row 3 Separate maintenance fee INR 15,000 per billing month
1 SERVICE LOCATION

1.1 Willow Housing Private Limited (P03, Maintenance Provider) shall support urgent electrical and
access-control faults at Aurora Software Private Limited (P01, Occupier) office UNIT-5. The underlying
occupancy remains governed by C05.
2 DISPATCH INSTRUCTION

2.1 For an urgent ticket received by Willow, an acknowledgement identifying the ticket and dispatch contact
must be sent within 4 elapsed hours of that receipt. An acknowledgement at the exact deadline is timely.

2.2 Measure from the evidenced provider_received_at time, not from a later monitoring-system receipt. A ticket
for another location does not trigger this work order.
3 EMERGENCY COST ACCOUNT

3.1 If Willow misses the acknowledgement deadline, it shall reimburse Aurora actual emergency repair costs
approved by Kavya Paul and evidenced by a receipt, up to INR 25,000 per ticket. No cost is payable from the
missed deadline alone.
C12 | Emergency Maintenance Order Page 1
WILLOW HOUSING / C12

3.2 Do not charge the monthly fee again as an emergency penalty. Insurance or a hypothetical contractor
quotation does not establish an incurred approved cost.
4 WORK-ORDER PRICE

4.1 The term is 2027-01-11 through 2027-12-31 without auto-renewal. Aurora pays Willow INR 15,000 per
billing month by day 10 of the following month at 17:00 UTC against MAINT-YYYY-MM. The first partial month
is charged at the full fee and due on 2027-02-10. No late interest is agreed; the fee is distinct from rent.
5 CORRECTION AND CANCELLATION

5.1 A recurring service failure requires written notice and 7 calendar days for corrective measures before
termination for cause. Either party may cancel for convenience on 30 calendar days notice, without cancelling
the separate lease.

reference_context.text:
1.1 Aurora Software Private Limited (P01) and Forge Electronics Private Limited (P02) are each a
Discloser when providing information and a Recipient when receiving it. No payment is due merely for
entering this undertaking.
2 PROTECTED MATERIAL

2.1 Engineering drawings, source code, controller test reports and credentials disclosed in confidence are
Protected Material. Information already public without breach, independently developed or lawfully
obtained without restriction is excluded.
3 RECIPIENT PROMISES

3.1 The Recipient shall use Protected Material solely for evaluating and implementing the parties
integration work, limit access to personnel with a need to know and equivalent confidentiality duties, and
apply reasonable access controls.

3.2 A mandatory legal disclosure requires prior notice where permitted and disclosure only to the required
extent. No ownership, sublicensing or general commercialization right is granted.
4 PERIOD OF PROTECTION

4.1 The exchange period is 2026-12-20 through 2027-12-19, without auto-renewal. Confidentiality
continues for 3 years after each disclosure. Either party may end future exchanges on 15 days notice,
without releasing accrued duties.
5 RETURN OR DESTRUCTION

5.1 On an evidenced written request, the Recipient shall return or destroy the specified material and
supply a signed attestation by 17:00 UTC on the tenth calendar date following receipt. Dispatch of a
request alone is insufficient.

5.2 Copies legally required to be retained must be identified, segregated and remain protected. No legally
required retention is presumed without evidence. An attestation must identify the request and material
inventory.
C13 | Engineering Confidentiality Page 1
AURORA SOFTWARE / C13
6 RELIEF AND LIMITS

6.1 A delayed return attestation permits a request for performance, injunctive relief and supported
damages but carries no fixed return-delay fee. Each party bears third-party claims caused by its own
unauthorized disclosure; an unknown damages amount is not zero.

6.2 For a proven unauthorized disclosure, the responsible Recipient owes INR 100,000 for each distinct
unauthorized recipient, capped at INR 300,000 in total under this undertaking. Disclosure evidence must
identify the protected material and recipient. A missing return attestation does not itself prove a disclosure
and must not trigger this sum.
7 GENERAL PROMISES

7.1 Neither party may assign the undertaking without written consent. Applicable privacy law governs
personal data in the exchange. Force majeure does not make an intentional disclosure permissible. The
parties first seek resolution between legal contacts; Bengaluru courts and Indian law govern remaining
disputes.
8 SIGNED UNDERTAKING

aurora-legal@aurora.example and notices@forge.example. UTC and calendar days apply.

reference_context.text:
1.1 Aurora Software Private Limited (P01) shall provide recovery service DR-RESIDENT for Willow
Housing Private Limited (P03), covering DS-HOUSING and the APP-HABITAT recovery copy. Controller
and Processor roles remain as in C07.

1.2 The service uses the backup nodes hired under C09. Their hire ends on 2027-06-30, while this
schedule continues through 2027-12-15; no extension or substitute equipment is attached.
2 ACTIVATION AND RESTORATION

2.1 A recovery activation accepted from Kavya Paul starts a 4-elapsed-hour restoration window. Aurora
must restore the complete recovery copy within that window. An evidenced completion at exactly 4 hours
satisfies the target.

2.2 The activation and completion must identify DR-RESIDENT and the same activation ID. A partial
restore is not completion. A recovery exercise alone is not proof of production unavailability or
unauthorized disclosure.
3 COMMERCIAL ADJUSTMENT

3.1 Willow pays Aurora INR 40,000 per billing month by day 5 of the following month at 17:00 UTC
against RECOVERY-YYYY-MM. The first partial month 2027-01-13 through 2027-01-31 is billed at the
full fee and due on 2027-02-05. No late-payment interest is specified.

3.2 A missed restoration window earns Willow a credit of 20 percent of the monthly recovery fee, capped
at INR 8,000 for the month. Only one such credit applies in a month and no additional speculative loss is
included.

3.3 Do not import the APP-ATLAS hosting thresholds from C01 or a monthly APP-HABITAT availability
result from C10 into this elapsed recovery test. Each remedy retains its own evidence requirements.
C14 | Recovery Service Schedule Page 1
AURORA SOFTWARE / C14
4 HANDLING OF RECOVERY COPIES

4.1 Recovered resident information remains confidential and subject to the processing instructions and

reference_context.text:
1.1 Forge Electronics Private Limited (P02, Warrantor) gives Aurora Software Private Limited (P01, Buyer)
this undertaking for the AX-7 controllers supplied under PO-AX7 and C03. Each claim must identify a
covered serial number and its original conforming acceptance date.
2 COVERAGE

2.1 Manufacturing defects arising in normal use are covered for 12 calendar months from the original
acceptance date. Physical misuse, unauthorized modification and ordinary wear are excluded only when
supported by evidence. A replacement does not reset the original warranty period.
3 CLAIM AND REPLACEMENT

3.1 A claim received at notices@forge.example must identify its claim ID, serial number, acceptance record
and defect evidence. A complete claim within coverage starts the replacement process.

3.2 Forge shall deliver a conforming replacement by 17:00 UTC on the tenth calendar date following receipt
of a valid claim. Receipt at the exact deadline is timely; dispatch is not delivery.

3.3 For each started UTC calendar date after the replacement due date when the replacement remains
undelivered at 00:00 UTC, Forge owes Aurora INR 1,000, capped at INR 10,000 per claim. These charges
do not extinguish the replacement duty. No full purchase-price refund follows automatically from a delay.
4 TRANSPORT AND INFORMATION

4.1 Forge bears reasonable return transport for an accepted covered claim. Aurora shall remove data and
protect credentials before return. Technical claim records are confidential for 2 years, subject to mandatory
legal disclosure and applicable privacy law.
C15 | Ax-7 Warranty Undertaking Page 1
FORGE ELECTRONICS / C15
5 PRICE ALLOCATION

5.1 Warranty coverage is included in the price under C03. This undertaking creates no separate warranty
subscription fee and does not add another INR 500,000 to that purchase.
6 REMEDIES AND FORUM

6.1 Ordinary warranty damages are capped at INR 250,000, excluding fraud and each party indemnity for
third-party claims caused by its own infringement. No damages amount follows from that cap alone. Indian
law and Bengaluru courts govern warranty disputes independently of a downstream resale.
7 CONTINUING RIGHTS

7.1 The undertaking operates from 2027-01-14 through 2027-12-20 without auto-renewal. Coverage already
earned by original acceptance survives until its own expiry. Material breach allows termination of future
obligations after 10 calendar days written cure notice, without extinguishing earned coverage.

7.2 Neither party may assign this undertaking without consent. Force majeure relief requires proof, notice
and mitigation and does not automatically defeat a replacement claim. There is no exclusivity beyond any
separate express procurement promise.
8 WARRANTOR AND BUYER

8.1 Mira Sen for Aurora and Anil Das for Forge record execution on 2026-12-24. Notices to Aurora use
aurora-legal@aurora.example. All dates use calendar days and UTC.
